target.title: fix(whatsapp): serialize overlapping Web sends
target.body:
﻿Closes #99049

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where WhatsApp Web users sending overlapping replies, media, reactions, or queued outbound messages through the same active account could have multiple raw Baileys `sendMessage` calls in flight on the same socket. In bursty channel traffic, that left message ordering and socket state coordination to the underlying client instead of OpenClaw enforcing one active send at a time.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change serializes WhatsApp Web `sendMessage` calls at the Web send API facade and at the shared socket-operation timeout boundary. The socket-level queue is keyed by the Baileys socket object so sibling send paths that create separate timeout adapters still coordinate, while presence updates remain outside the queue and the existing timeout behavior is preserved.

## User Impact

WhatsApp Web operators should see more deterministic outbound delivery under concurrent sends for the same account. No configuration changes are required, and the change is scoped to outbound `sendMessage` ordering rather than account setup, inbound monitoring, or retry policy.

## Evidence

- Source-level before condition: the existing socket timeout wrapper bounded each send independently, but separate adapters around the same Baileys socket did not coordinate FIFO access to `sock.sendMessage`.
- Added focused regression coverage that holds the first `sendMessage` pending and verifies a second send does not reach the raw socket until the first settles through `createWebSendApi`.
- Added shared-adapter regression coverage that creates sibling timeout adapters for the same socket and verifies the same per-socket FIFO behavior.

- `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/send-api.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/socket-timing.test.ts` -> 2 files passed, 47 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec oxlint extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/send-api.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/send-api.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/socket-timing.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/socket-timing.test.ts`
